title: NFTokenCreateOffer
key_points: The NFTokenCreateOffer transaction type allows an account to create a new NFT offer.
The transaction requires a 'TransactionType' field with value 6 (NFTokenCreateOffer).
Fields include the seller account, NFT offer details, and any additional metadata.
limitations: Scope is limited to the NFTokenCreateOffer transaction type within the XRPL protocol documentation.
asserts: The source claims that the NFTokenCreateOffer transaction enables an account to create a new non-fungible token offer on the XRPL blockchain.
scope: The scope of this assertion is the context of creating and specifying non-fungible token offers using the NFTokenCreateOffer transaction type in the XRPL protocol.
